BiblicalUsage: Maats was a son of Ram, the firstborn of Jerahmeel, named in the genealogy of Judah. His brothers were Jamin and Eker, and his name stands in the record of the family of Hezron.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Maats is kept in the record because God counts the families of Judah by name, and no branch of the line is forgotten.
